comment: THE BOOTSTRAP RESIDUE (journey-closure E8): the boot double's class
set is DERIVED (scripts/regen-node-vocab.mjs --boot) as the probe
address set (every facts row's card, composed through the dead-card
wall's probe law) plus THESE rows — the classes the walls' hermetic
composes address through lane-gated branches the fill loop cannot
unlock (the h3 film graph's served lanes, the studio corpus's
stamp/knob members, the detailer stack's provider lanes). Every row
carries its justification; a row the census no longer serves is a
regen REFUSAL, and the derivation arm
fixture against exactly address-set + these rows — an unreceipted
extra row reds as over-growth, a missing addressed class reds as
stale. Pruning a row: delete it here with the consumer wall that
proved it dead named in the pruning commit.
